summary: No reachable vulnerability. (1) Tampered/unknown style on resume: restoreSession -> parseSessionRecord rejects any bot seat whose style is not in BOT_STYLES (src/table/session-record.ts:203) and any non-bot seat with a non-null style (:197), so nextHand (src/table/session.ts ~558) only ever copies a style that was already validated and already in play on that seat; it fails closed via RangeError before a table exists. Live-play seats come from lineUpSessionConfig/assertSessionConfig, which also check BOT_STYLES. (2) Old replay codes: the deck/seat streams (seatGenerator, botDecisionSeed) are unchanged; only the replacement-style stream (replacementGenerator, the '/replace' suffix) was removed, so an old playtest Replay line that involved a bust replays with the same-style rule rather than the old draw. That is a reproducibility/behaviour change, not a security issue, and it is handled by A-7 (explicit --styles). Removing the throw on a null replayCode removes a crash path, not a check. (3) Randomness: no new draw is introduced; one seeded draw is removed, and no Math.random was added. Shuffling still uses the existing generator. Style JSON retunes are static bundled data and take no input. No new dependencies.
